description: Unit test class for AdvancedPaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor, testing various scenarios including charge payments, credit transactions, disbursements, and transaction lookups in the context of loan payment processing.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for AdvancedPaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor, testing payment processing and transaction lookup logic.

methods.name: chargePaymentTransactionTestWithExactAmount
methods.description: Test processing of a charge payment transaction with an exact amount equal to the outstanding charge.

methods.name: chargePaymentTransactionTestWithLessTransactionAmount
methods.description: Test processing of a charge payment transaction with an amount less than the charge outstanding.

methods.name: chargePaymentTransactionTestWithMoreTransactionAmount
methods.description: Test processing of a charge payment transaction with an amount exceeding the charge outstanding.

methods.name: testProcessCreditTransactionWithAllocationRulePrincipalPenaltyFeeInterest
methods.description: Test processing of a credit transaction with a specific allocation rule involving principal, penalty, fee, and interest.

methods.name: testProcessCreditTransactionWithAllocationRulePenaltyFeePrincipalInterest
methods.description: Test processing of a credit transaction with a different allocation rule involving penalty, fee, principal, and interest.

methods.name: testProcessCreditTransactionWithAllocationRulePrincipalAndInterestWithAdditionalInstallment
methods.description: Test credit processing involving multiple installments with additional installment scenarios.

methods.name: testProcessLatestTransaction_PassesThroughHandlingPaymentAllocationForInterestBearingProgressiveLoan
methods.description: Test the handling of payment allocations for interest bearing progressive loans, verifying integration with the EMI calculator.

methods.name: testDisbursementAfterMaturityDateWithEMICalculator
methods.description: Test processing a disbursement scheduled after the loan's maturity date, ensuring EMI calculator handles excess disbursement correctly.

methods.description: Utility method to create mock LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment objects with specified due date and additional flag.

methods.name: createMockCreditAllocationRule
methods.description: Utility method to create mock LoanCreditAllocationRule with specified allocation types.

methods.name: createRepayment
methods.description: Utility method to create mock LoanTransaction objects representing repayments.

methods.name: createChargebackTransaction
methods.description: Utility method to create mock LoanTransaction objects representing chargebacks.

methods.name: calculateChargebackAllocationMap
methods.description: Test the calculation logic for chargeback allocation map across various scenarios with different allocations and amounts.
